title: Maserati MC20 in the Garage on a Rainy Night
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
description:
Midnight Garage: a papaya orange Maserati MC20 in the garage on a rainy night, rain on the garage roof and a warm light on. 3 hours of slow, original lo-fi, music only, for working, studying, relaxing or drifting off to sleep.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original to this channel.

PARKED FM | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
